name: Health & Directions Scenario
description: Conversation profile for practicing health-related dialogues, asking directions, and making decisions

customPrompts.feedbackStyle: Be supportive and practical. Help the student understand real-world situations like asking for directions, describing symptoms, and making decisions.
customPrompts.adaptationInstructions: When the user makes a choice (e.g., pharmacy vs clinic), ALWAYS remember and respect that choice throughout the conversation. Adapt subsequent questions to match their choice.
